paper.title_en: Near-Horizon Deformation of Metric and the Black Hole Instability
paper.abstract_en: Recent time-domain analyses suggest that black hole stability may be sensitive to localized near-horizon geometric deformations, while the underlying spectral mechanism remain unclear. In this work, after verifying the instability of the model in the time domain, we systematically investigate quasi-normal mode spectra under static localized non-positive perturbations within a frequency-domain framework. We find that such deformations generically induce a new purely imaginary mode. As the deformation approaches the horizon, the imaginary part of this mode increases and eventually enters the upper half complex-frequency plane, signaling the onset of black hole instability. Numerical results reveal clear scaling relations between the critical distance for instability and the deformation strength. We further derive rigorous proofs for our discoveries in frequency domain. These results demonstrate that black hole stability under long scale is conditionally sensitive to localized deformation of metric near the horizon and establish a unified spectral framework for understanding their induced instabilities.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在频域框架下系统研究视界附近度规局域非正扰动下的准正规模谱，发现新出现的纯虚模式随扰动靠近视界而进入上半复频率平面，给出不稳定临界距离与扰动强度的标度关系，并声称给出严格频域证明。属于广义相对论基础中黑洞稳定性问题，兼具谱方法与视界几何形变的理论深度，值得点入阅读。
decision.title_zh: 度规的近视界形变与黑洞不稳定性
decision.abstract_zh: 近期时域分析表明，黑洞稳定性可能对局域的近视界几何形变敏感，而其背后的谱机制仍不清楚。在本工作中，在时域中验证了该模型的不稳定性之后，我们在频域框架内系统地研究了静态局域非正扰动下的准正规模谱。我们发现，此类形变普遍会诱导出一个新的纯虚模式。当形变趋近视界时，该模式的虚部增大并最终进入上半复频率平面，标志着黑洞不稳定性的出现。数值结果揭示了不稳定性临界距离与形变强度之间的清晰标度关系。我们进一步在频域中为我们的发现给出了严格的证明。这些结果表明，长尺度下的黑洞稳定性对视界附近度规的局域形变具有条件敏感性，并建立了一个统一的谱框架来理解它们所诱导的不稳定性。
